# !!!LEARNING!!!

## Orders

Report documentation validation, application tests, simulated-provider evaluation, and live-model evaluation separately. Use PostgreSQL for checks that depend on its database behavior.

## Refinements

Application tests are unavailable before scaffolding. A passing documentation validator only establishes the checks named in its output; it cannot establish working product behavior.

Future lessons should identify the failing input, expected result, actual result, fix, and repeatable verification command.
